attempts.summary: Implemented host-based port isolation between node2 and node3 (both RHEL7, sharing the 10.100.80.0/24 segment with node1) using firewalld rich rules: node2 drops all traffic sourced from node3's IP (10.100.80.12) and node3 drops all traffic sourced from node2's IP (10.100.80.11), applied both at runtime and permanently. Verified direct node2<->node3 ping fails (100% loss) while both retain full bidirectional connectivity to node1. Then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three managed nodes (node1 via SONiC `reboot`, node2/node3 via RHEL7 `sudo reboot`), confirming a changed OS boot_id and full recovery of services, firewalld state, and isolation behavior after each restart before proceeding to the next node.
